payout_value_note: Flat $25 per qualifying referral (reward may be an e-Gift Card or other form at the CU's discretion); headline cap of $300 in referral bonuses per year.
payout_quote: Once your friend uses your link to apply online to become a Community First member and opens a new checking account, you'll both get a $25 e-Gift Card. The more friends you refer, the more you earn! You can earn up to $300 in referral bonuses every year.
numeric_basis: payout from official refer.communityfirstfl.org program page ('you'll both get a $25 e-Gift Card'; 'earn up to $300 in referral bonuses every year'); time: creating and sharing referral link est. 5-15 min active
eligibility: Current Community First Credit Union (of Florida, communityfirstfl.org) members; friends must be new members who apply online via the referral link and open a new checking account.
steps: Be a Community First Credit Union (Florida) member
Create your personal referral link by entering the email associated with your Community First account
Share your referral link with friends so they can join Community First
Friend uses your link to apply online to become a Community First member and opens a new checking account
You both get a $25 e-Gift Card

s3.note: Qualification summary: friend completes the referral as described in the referral message, applies online to become a member, and opens a new checking account

s4.note: Timing: rewards subject to verification; no exact payout timing stated

s6.note: No fee to refer or participate
